children: According to CNBC, Anthropic raised a record $81 billion in its IPO and secured an additional $26 billion from technology companies that bought shares at the offering price. The stock rose 17% in its Thursday debut, giving the company a $1.8 trillion market capitalization. The debut came as technology shares suffered their worst week since 2020: Nvidia fell 23%, its sharpest weekly decline in 18 years, and the Nasdaq dropped 10% over the past five trading days.

title: Anthropic's Record IPO Debut Coincides With Tech's Worst Week on Wall Street Since 2020
